about.title: About Us
about.description: Learn about MotoTrip's story and mission
about.subtitle: Connecting riders through the world's best routes

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: We believe the best memories are made on the road. MotoTrip was born from a passion for motorcycling and a desire to share the world's most incredible routes. Our platform connects riders, allowing them to share experiences and discover new adventures.

community.title: Community
community.description: We build a global community of riders who share a passion for the road and a spirit of adventure.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: We prioritize safety in all routes, providing detailed information about road conditions and difficulty levels.

adventure.title: Adventure
adventure.description: We encourage exploration and discovery of new places, always respecting nature and local communities.

global.title: Global
global.description: We connect riders from all continents, creating a truly international network of enthusiasts.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: MotoTrip started in 2024 when a group of motorcycle friends realized there was a lack of a dedicated platform for sharing and discovering amazing motorcycle routes.
story.paragraph2: Tired of relying solely on navigation apps that didn't capture the essence of a good motorcycle route, we decided to create something different. A platform where the community could share not just GPS coordinates, but stories, photos, and real experiences.
story.paragraph3: Today, thousands of riders around the world use MotoTrip to plan their next adventures, discover scenic routes, and connect with other enthusiasts who share the same passion for two wheels.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.description: Rules and best practices for the MotoTrip community
guidelines.subtitle: Building a respectful and helpful community for all riders
guidelines.intro: Welcome to the MotoTrip Community Guidelines. These rules help us maintain a positive, safe, and helpful environment for all members. By using our platform, you agree to follow these guidelines.

respect.title: Respect
respect.description: Treat all members with respect and courtesy. Differences of opinion are welcome, but always keep discussions civil.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: Always prioritize safety on the roads. Share accurate information and warnings about dangerous conditions.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: Work together with other members. Share knowledge, provide constructive feedback, and help improve the community.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Maintain high standards in your contributions. Provide detailed and accurate information about routes.

content.title: Content Guidelines
content.description: When sharing routes and interacting with the community:

do.title: Do:
do.item1: Provide detailed and accurate route descriptions
do.item2: Include warnings about road conditions and difficulty levels
do.item3: Use your own photos or those with appropriate permission
do.item5: Be honest in your reviews and comments

dont.title: Don't:
dont.item1: Post offensive, discriminatory, or illegal content
dont.item4: Use others' photos or content without permission

reporting.title: Report Violations
reporting.description: If you encounter content that violates these guidelines, please let us know:

consequences.title: Consequences
consequences.description: Violations of these guidelines may result in:
consequences.item1: Warning and request to remove/modify content
consequences.item3: Permanent ban in severe or repeat cases
